LESSON: PETER’S MIRACULOUS RESCUE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.4: Peter’s miraculous rescue

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Peter’s miraculous rescue
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How was Apostle Peter rescued from prison?

• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “retell the story of Peter’s miraculous rescue from prison” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

• Model 1: retell the story of Peter’s miraculous rescue from prison
